title: Borland claims first-hand knowledge of crash recovery, reverse engineering and the power source

tellings.quote: I have direct first-hand knowledge and exposure to crash recovery, reverse engineering, integration of technology into

plain: A man named Dylan Borland says he has direct, first-hand knowledge of crash recovery, meaning the retrieval of downed craft that are not of human make. He says he has also seen the reverse engineering of that technology, how it was built into other systems, and its power source. He makes the claim in his own words in a clip shown on an episode with Jeremy Corbell, and if it were true it would mean such craft have been recovered and studied in secret.
